schemes.title: கலைஞர் மகளிர் உரிமைத் தொகை 2026 — ₹1,000/மாதம் | Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai Tamil Nadu
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu government's Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai scheme provides Rs.1,000 per month directly to the bank accounts of the female head of each eligible family via DBT. Launched in September 2023, over 1 crore women across Tamil Nadu receive this benefit. The scheme aims to promote financial autonomy and economic empowerment of women across all districts

schemes.title: Pudhumai Penn Scheme Tamil Nadu 2026 — ₹1,000/Month for Girl Students Class 6–12
schemes.benefit_summary: Pudhumai Penn (Modern Woman) Scheme is Tamil Nadu's flagship girl education scheme launched by CM MK Stalin in September 2022. It provides ₹1,000 per month directly to the bank accounts of girl students studying in Classes 6 to 12 in Tamil Nadu government schools. The scheme targets the critical transition period (Class 6 onwards) when dropout rates are highest due to financial pressure. Over 9 lakh girl students across Tamil Nadu receive this benefit every month via DBT. The girl's own bank account is opened at nationalised banks — no guardian's account. This ₹12,000/year support helps girls buy notebooks, uniforms, and manage travel expenses, directly reducing family financial burden and keeping girls in school through Class 12

schemes.title: தமிழ்நாடு முதல்வர் காலை உணவு திட்டம் 2026 — TN CM Breakfast Scheme: Free Breakfast for Govt School Kids
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Breakfast Scheme provides free nutritious breakfast to students studying in government primary schools (Classes 1–5) every school day. Launched in September 2022 by CM MK Stalin, the scheme covers over 1.14 lakh students across 1,545 government primary schools initially, now expanded to 5,016+ schools statewide

schemes.title: நான் முதல்வன் திட்டம் 2026 — TN Youth Skill + ₹1,000-3,000/Month Stipend
schemes.benefit_summary: Naan Mudhalvan (I am the First) is Tamil Nadu government's flagship skill development and employability scheme for students in Classes 6-12 and higher education. It provides free certification courses in IT, digital skills, NEET/JEE coaching, industry certifications, and soft skills. Students also get paid internship support with stipend ₹1,000-3,000/month. Over 50 lakh students enrolled

schemes.title: மூவலூர் ராமாமிர்தம் அம்மையார் திட்டம் 2026 — ₹1,000/மாதம் TN College Girl Students
schemes.benefit_summary: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme provides ₹1,000 per month stipend to girls from first-generation college-going families (parents are not college graduates) studying in Tamil Nadu government arts and science colleges, polytechnics, and government engineering colleges. The scheme encourages girls to pursue higher education

schemes.title: Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam Tamil Nadu 2026 — Free Doorstep Healthcare
schemes.benefit_summary: Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam, meaning Healthcare at Your Doorstep, is a flagship public-health initiative of the Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of Tamil Nadu, launched by Chief Minister MK Stalin in 2021. Instead of waiting for patients to reach a hospital, teams of ASHA workers and nurses make weekly visits to every household across the state to screen residents for 27 diseases and health conditions, including diabetes, hypertension, tuberculosis, oral and cervical cancer, and mental-health issues. Free medicines are dispensed on the spot for treatable conditions, and patients needing advanced care receive a referral to a Government hospital. With over 3.5 crore households covered, the programme removes cost and distance as barriers to early diagnosis, especially for the elderly, differently-abled, and chronically ill

schemes.title: Ennum Ezhuthum Mission TN 2026 — Free Tablet + Numeracy/Literacy for Govt School Students
schemes.benefit_summary: Ennum Ezhuthum, the Numeracy and Literacy Mission of the School Education Department, Government of Tamil Nadu, is designed to make sure every Class 1 to 3 child in a government school masters foundational reading, writing and arithmetic — the skills that all later learning depends on. The mission uses Activity-Based Learning methods so that early-grade teaching is playful and child-centred rather than rote. As an extension of the same digital-education push, the state distributes free tablets to Class 6, 7 and 8 students in government and government-aided schools, delivered through the school headmaster with no separate application. Benefiting over 40 lakh students annually, the programme combines classroom reform with hardware support to close learning gaps in public education across Tamil Nadu

schemes.title: விடியல் பயணம் (Free Bus Travel) Tamil Nadu 2023 — அனைத்து பெண்களுக்கும் இலவச பேருந்து பயணம்
schemes.benefit_summary: Vidiyal Payanam (Dawn Journey) is Tamil Nadu government's scheme providing absolutely free bus travel to all women passengers on Tamil Nadu State Transport Corporation (TNSTC) and Metropolitan Transport Corporation (MTC) buses across the state. Launched by CM Stalin in September 2021, the scheme covers all women — no income restriction. Over 40 lakh women travel free daily. Women simply board any TNSTC/MTC bus without purchasing a ticket

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu CM Free Laptop Scheme 2026 — Class 11-12 & College Students | 20 Lakh Laptops
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister Free Laptop Scheme (restarted under CM Stalin's DMK government) provides free laptops to government and government-aided school students in Class 11, Class 12, and first-year college students. Over 20 lakh laptops distributed since 2011 (AIADMK era) and the scheme continues. Class 11-12 students in government schools get laptops at the start of academic year. Laptops come pre-loaded with educational software and internet connectivity support

schemes.title: கலைஞர் கனவு இல்லம் தமிழ்நாடு 2026 — 1 லட்சம் இலவச வீடுகள் | Urban Free Housing Scheme
schemes.benefit_summary: Kalaignar Kanavu Illam (Kalaignar's Dream Home) is Tamil Nadu government's urban affordable housing scheme targeting construction of 1 lakh free houses for the poor and economically weaker sections in urban and peri-urban areas. Announced by CM Stalin as part of the DMK government's housing push. Beneficiaries are identified through income surveys and TNUHDB (Tamil Nadu Urban Habitat Development Board). Houses are provided under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Urban (PMAY-U) convergence

schemes.title: கலைஞர் மு.க திட்டம் தமிழ்நாடு 2026 — ₹5 லட்சம் அறுவை சிகிச்சை மருத்துவக் காப்பீடு | TN CM Health Insurance
schemes.benefit_summary: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS), branded as Kalaignar Muthalvarin Thitta Nala Thittam in Tamil Nadu, provides cashless health insurance coverage of up to Rs 5 lakh per year for major surgeries and treatments at empanelled government and private hospitals. Different from the central Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY, this state scheme covers procedures not included in PMJAY and has a higher per-procedure coverage. About 5 lakh+ surgeries are performed annually. Covers all families with annual income up to Rs 72,000 and TNPDS ration card holders

schemes.title: அம்மா இரு சக்கர வாகன திட்டம் தமிழ்நாடு 2026 — பணிபுரியும் பெண்களுக்கு Two-Wheeler Subsidy | Amma Scooter Scheme
schemes.benefit_summary: Amma Two Wheeler Scheme is Tamil Nadu government's scheme providing 50% subsidy on two-wheeler purchase (up to Rs 25,000) for working women in Tamil Nadu. Launched under DMK government 2021, the scheme targets women going to work who lack transport. The subsidy is given as bank loan interest subsidy — the state government pays 50% of the two-wheeler cost (capped at Rs 25,000). Approximately 10 lakh women benefit in Phase 1. Priority to government scheme beneficiaries, SHG members, and women from BPL families

schemes.title: Rajiv Gandhi Civil Abhayam Scheme Tamil Nadu 2026 — Free IAS/IPS Coaching for Economically Weak Students
schemes.benefit_summary: Rajiv Gandhi Civil Abhayam is Tamil Nadu government's free civil services coaching scheme for students from economically weak families who aspire to crack UPSC (IAS/IPS/IFS) and Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission (TNPSC) examinations. Launched in 2022 by the DMK government, it provides free residential coaching at select coaching centres across Tamil Nadu — covering tuition fees, study materials, hostel accommodation, food, and a monthly stipend. Eligible students are selected through a merit-cum-means written test. The scheme specifically targets students from SC, ST, OBC, MBC, and economically weaker general category backgrounds to bridge the coaching access gap between rich and poor aspirants

schemes.title: TN Free LPG Connection Scheme 2026 — Free Gas Connection + Stove + 2 Refills for Women
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Free LPG Connection Scheme provides FREE LPG connection, FREE double burner stove, and FREE 2 cylinder refills annually to women heads of BPL households in Tamil Nadu. Implemented by the TN Food and Consumer Protection Department, the scheme acts as a state top-up to central PMUY (Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana), extending benefits to families not covered by PMUY and offering EXTRA refills + stove. Targets 20 lakh+ BPL women in Tamil Nadu. Application at nearest Ration Shop or tnpds.gov.in portal

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Pongal Gift Scheme 2026 — ₹1,000 Cash + Free Rice, Sugar & Dhoti/Saree for Ration Card Holders
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu Pongal Gift Scheme is an annual state government initiative that provides free gifts to ration card (PDS) holders during the Pongal harvest festival (January). The scheme has evolved over years: Current package (2026): ₹1,000 cash transferred to Aadhaar-linked bank account + free rice (1-2 kg) + free sugar (1 kg) + free dhoti/saree (for priority households). Some years also include coconut, turmeric, and other festival items. Total value of Pongal package: approximately ₹1,500-2,000 per family. Implemented through Tamil Nadu Civil Supplies Corporation (TNCSC) and PDS ration shops. All eligible ration card holders automatically receive it — no separate application required. Over 2 crore ration card families benefit. Cash component is directly transferred via DBT ahead of Pongal festival (typically January 13-15)

schemes.title: TN Magalir Thittam (SHG) 2026 — ₹10,000 Revolving Fund + Loans for Women Self-Help Groups
schemes.benefit_summary: Magalir Thittam is Tamil Nadu's flagship women Self-Help Group (SHG) programme launched in 1997 under the Tamil Nadu Corporation for Development of Women (TNCDW). It has grown to become one of India's largest SHG networks with over 4.5 lakh SHGs covering 60 lakh women. Benefits: Revolving Fund (RF) of ₹10,000-15,000 per SHG for initial lending; Community Investment Fund (CIF) for group microenterprise; Bank linkage loans at 3% interest (subsidised by state); NABARD credit linkage. Women SHG members can access loans for business (₹50,000-3 lakh per member), education, housing, emergencies. Special schemes under Magalir Thittam: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai (₹1,000/month — separate scheme) is channelled through SHGs. SHG members also get priority in government scheme registration, livelihood training, and market access through SHG federations

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu BC/MBC/DNC Post-Matric Scholarship 2026 — ₹230-₹1,200/Month + Full Fees
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu's BC/MBC/DNC Post-Matric Scholarship is the state's largest single scholarship scheme by reach — approximately 12 lakh students receive support each year — reflecting the very large share of TN's population in Backward Class, Most Backward Class and De-Notified Community categories (jointly around 68% of state population). Unlike the central BC scholarship, this is a purely STATE-run programme administered by TN's BC, MBC and Minorities Welfare Department, disbursed through the Tamil Nadu e-Scholarship Portal at escholarship.tn.gov.in. The scheme distinctively covers **thesis typing and printing charges** for PG and PhD candidates plus study tour charges — components most state post-matric schemes do not fund. Maintenance ranges ₹230 to ₹1,200 per month by stage and hostel status, with full tuition reimbursement, compulsory non-refundable fees and a book allowance built in. TN maintains its own BC/MBC/DNC list separate from the central OBC list, and the underlying caste certificate must be issued by a TN Revenue Department competent authority

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu CM Solar Powered Pumpset Scheme 2026 — 80% Subsidy for Farmers
schemes.benefit_summary: Chief Minister's Solar Powered Pumpset Scheme is Tamil Nadu's flagship solar irrigation initiative launched in 2019 — providing up to 80% government subsidy (90% for SC/ST) for installing solar-powered pumpsets (3 HP, 5 HP, 7.5 HP) for agricultural irrigation. The scheme aims to reduce farmer's electricity cost, promote sustainable energy, and ensure round-the-clock irrigation. Subsidy structure: Central subsidy 30% (under PM-KUSUM) + State subsidy 50-60% = total 80-90% government share; farmer pays only 10-20%. A 5 HP solar pump costs ~₹3 lakh total — farmer pays only ₹30,000-60,000. Includes solar panels, motor pump, controller, accessories with 5-year warranty + 25-year solar panel performance warranty. Application via Tamil Nadu Energy Development Agency (TEDA) at teda.in

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Adi Dravidar Post-Matric Scholarship 2026 — Free Education for SC/ST
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu Adi Dravidar Post-Matric Scholarship is administered by the Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department for SC/ST students from Class 11 to PG and PhD studying in TN recognised institutions. Benefits: 100% tuition fee + non-refundable fee + maintenance allowance ₹230-₹1,200/month + study tour + thesis printing. Family income limit ₹2.5 lakh. Chief Minister Merit Award: ₹3,000 per annum for 5 years to 1,000 boys + 1,000 girls topping Class 12 from SC/ST/ADC Christian communities. The scheme is integrated with central NSP for OBC students. About 8 lakh+ SC/ST Tamil Nadu students benefit annually with ₹1,500+ crore disbursement. Apply at escholarship.tn.gov.in (window: August-December)

schemes.title: Dr Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Benefit TN 2026 — ₹18,000 for Pregnant Women
schemes.benefit_summary: Dr Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Benefit Scheme is Tamil Nadu's pioneering maternal welfare programme — providing ₹18,000 cash assistance per pregnancy (raised from ₹12,000 in 2021) to all pregnant women in Tamil Nadu, irrespective of order of birth. Named after Dr Muthulakshmi Reddy, Indian medical pioneer and social reformer. The scheme is administered by the Department of Public Health & Family Welfare and provides cash in 3 instalments: ₹2,000 on registration of pregnancy at primary health centre; ₹4,000 at 7th month antenatal check-up; ₹12,000 after delivery (at recognised institution) and BCG vaccination. The scheme is universal — no income limit — making it one of the most generous state maternity benefit schemes in India. Eligible women receive Mother & Child Protection (MCP) card from PHC. ~10 lakh+ pregnancies covered annually with ₹1,500+ crore outlay

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Old Age Pension 2026 — ₹1,000/Month for Senior Citizens
schemes.benefit_summary: Senior citizens in Tamil Nadu who have crossed 60 and have no reliable means of support can draw a monthly pension of ₹1,000 under the state's Old Age Pension scheme, run by the Department of Social Welfare and Women Empowerment. The payout blends a ₹800/month contribution from the state with the central IGNOAPS component — ₹200/month for those aged 60-79 and ₹500/month once a beneficiary turns 80 — pushing the total to as much as ₹1,500/month for the oldest pensioners. To qualify, a person must genuinely be without sufficient means of subsistence, have no family members supporting them, and keep annual household income under ₹1.2 lakh. More than 30 lakh senior citizens across the state currently draw this pension, either straight into an Aadhaar-linked bank account or via an Old Age Pension Booklet collected at the Taluk office, and applications go through the Taluk Social Welfare Officer or the nearest e-Sevai centre

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Differently Abled Pension 2026 — ₹1,500/Month for Persons with Disabilities
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu Differently Abled Pension is administered by the Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled — providing ₹1,500/month direct cash transfer to persons with 40%+ disability (severely disabled). The scheme combines TN state contribution (₹1,200/month) + central IGNDPS (₹300/month). Coverage includes 21 disabilities under RPwD Act 2016 — visual impairment, hearing impairment, locomotor disability, intellectual disability, mental illness, autism, cerebral palsy, multiple disabilities, etc. Eligibility: 40%+ benchmark disability with UDID Card, family income below ₹1.2 lakh, TN resident. ~12 lakh+ disability pension beneficiaries in TN as of 2026. Apply at e-Sevai centre or District Differently Abled Welfare Office. Distribution via Aadhaar-linked bank account. Special component for severely disabled (80%+): ₹1,800/month (state ₹1,500 + central ₹300)

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Widow Pension 2026 — ₹1,000/Month for Destitute Widows
schemes.benefit_summary: Widows in Tamil Nadu who are left without adequate support can claim a monthly pension of ₹1,000-1,300 through a scheme run by the Department of Social Welfare and Women Empowerment, funded jointly by the state government and the central IGNWPS (Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme). Tamil Nadu's own portion covers destitute widows of any age from 18 upward, while the central IGNWPS piece specifically applies to widows between 40 and 79 whose family income falls below the BPL line. Once a beneficiary turns 80, the payout steps up to ₹1,500/month. Around 14 lakh widows across the state are currently on this pension, and continuing to receive it requires staying unmarried — applications and renewals go through the Taluk Social Welfare Office or an e-Sevai centre, with payments reaching an Aadhaar-linked bank account

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Marriage Assistance Schemes 2026 — ₹25,000-₹50,000 + 8g Gold Coin for Brides
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu has 7 comprehensive Marriage Assistance Schemes (collectively administered by Department of Social Welfare) — providing one-time cash assistance + 8g gold coin for thali to deserving brides at the time of marriage. Schemes: (1) Dr Dharmambal Ammaiyar Memorial — for widow's daughter (₹25,000 + 8g gold); (2) E.V.R. Maniammaiyar Ninaivu — for daughters of poor widows (₹25,000 + 8g gold); (3) Annai Theresa Ninaivu — for orphan girls (₹25,000 + 8g gold); (4) Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Ninaivu — for poor girls (graduation or 10+2 educated, ₹25,000-50,000 + 8g gold based on education); (5) Dr Muthulakshmi Reddy Memorial — for inter-caste marriage (₹50,000 + 8g gold); (6) Annai Mary Ammaiyar — for Adi Dravidar Christians; (7) Periyar E.V. Ramasamy Ninaivu — for Sangam-caste women. Gold rate is fixed market value at the time of disbursement. ~3 lakh+ marriages assisted annually

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu TAHDCO SC/ST Housing & Enterprise Loan 2026 — ₹10L at 4% for Adi Dravidar Families
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu Adi Dravidar Housing and Development Corporation (TAHDCO) provides low-interest loans and subsidies to Scheduled Caste (Adi Dravidar) and Scheduled Tribe (Tribal) families in Tamil Nadu for housing, self-employment, and education. Key loans: (1) Housing Loan — ₹1-3 lakh at 4% for new construction/repair with 25% subsidy component; (2) Self-Employment Loan — ₹50,000-₹10 lakh at 4% for micro-enterprise; (3) Education Loan — professional courses ₹2-₹10 lakh at 4%; (4) Women's Self-Help Group Loans — ₹50,000-₹3 lakh at 4%; (5) NSFDC national-level loans up to ₹20 lakh for viable projects. 3 lakh+ SC/ST families benefited annually. Apply at TAHDCO district offices or tahdco.tn.gov.in

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Construction Workers Welfare Board 2026 — ₹5L Accident + Maternity + Education for 30L Workers
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu's Building & Other Construction Workers (BOCW) Welfare Board looks after more than 30 lakh registered construction workers across the state through a wide safety net rather than a single benefit. It pays ₹5 lakh for accidental death and ₹3 lakh for accidental disability, ₹1 lakh relief for natural death, and ₹6,000 in maternity benefit across two deliveries, while workers' children can draw an education scholarship ranging from ₹600 to ₹15,000 a year depending on the course. There's also ₹5,000 in marriage assistance, a ₹1,500/month pension once a worker crosses 60, ₹2,000 towards buying tools, and medical reimbursement up to ₹2,000. Registration costs just ₹25 a year plus an employer cess, and workers sign up through the Tamil Nadu Labour Department or the bocww.labour.tn.gov.in portal

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Agricultural Labourers Welfare Board 2026 — ₹3L Accident + ₹2,000/Month Pension for Farm Workers
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu Agricultural Labourers Welfare Board (TNALWB) provides comprehensive social security to landless agricultural labourers in Tamil Nadu — harvesters, transplanting workers, farm hired labourers, and related workers. Benefits: (1) Accident death ₹3 lakh, disability ₹1.5 lakh; (2) Pension ₹2,000/month after age 60 (combined state + central); (3) Maternity ₹12,000 (2 deliveries); (4) Marriage assistance ₹5,000 (daughter's marriage); (5) Children education scholarship ₹3,000-₹8,000/year; (6) Tool/equipment assistance ₹2,000. Annual registration ₹25. Managed by Labour Department Tamil Nadu. Over 45 lakh agricultural labourers registered

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Marine Fishermen Welfare Scheme 2026 — ₹10L Accident Insurance + Boat Subsidy + Lean Season ₹5,000
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu Fisheries Department provides comprehensive welfare to Tamil Nadu's 9+ lakh marine fishermen in coastal districts (Chennai, Nagapattinam, Rameswaram, Tuticorin, Kanyakumari, Thanjavur, Cuddalore, etc.). Benefits: (1) Group Accident Insurance ₹5-₹10 lakh (accidental death at sea); (2) Boat engine subsidy 50% up to ₹1 lakh; (3) Fishing net subsidy 50%; (4) Lean season relief (ban period): ₹5,000 cash per family; (5) Keezhadi fishing village housing; (6) Fishermen Savings-cum-Relief (SCR) Scheme ₹3,000/month deposit during fishing + ₹5,000 relief during ban; (7) Free weather warning SMS system. Apply at District Fisheries Department offices

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Public Relief Fund 2026 — Emergency Assistance for Natural Disaster, Disease, Accident
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Public Relief Fund (CMPRF) provides immediate emergency financial assistance to individuals and families facing genuine hardship due to natural disasters (flood, cyclone, drought, landslide), serious illness requiring expensive treatment, death in accident, fire damage, or other extreme emergencies. Assistance ranges from ₹10,000 to ₹5 lakh depending on the nature and severity of distress. Applications are reviewed by district collectors and approved by CM's Office. CMPRF is also a public donation fund — individuals and organizations can donate to CMPRF. Victims of Chennai floods, cyclones in coastal districts, and disasters in Nilgiris, Erode, Salem hill areas get priority

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Handloom Weavers Welfare Board 2026 — ₹2L Insurance + ₹15,000 Scholarship + Marketing for TN Weavers
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu Handloom Weavers' Cooperative Society (Co-optex) and Tamil Nadu Handloom Development Corporation (TNHDC) provide comprehensive welfare and marketing support to 5 lakh+ handloom weavers producing Kanchipuram silk, Coimbatore cotton, Salem fabric, Madurai Sungudi, Thanjavur weaving, and Bhavani jamakkalam. Benefits: (1) Mahatma Gandhi Bunkar Bima Yojana (MGBBY) — ₹2 lakh accident + ₹60,000 natural death insurance (BPL premium-free); (2) Children scholarship ₹100-₹150/month; (3) TNHDC yarn subsidy 15%; (4) Weaver Credit Card ₹2 lakh at 7%; (5) Co-optex showroom direct selling with better margins. Apply at District Handloom Officer or TNHDC

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Unorganised Workers Social Security Scheme 2026 — ₹2L Insurance + Pension for Street Vendors, Domestic Workers
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu Unorganised Workers Social Security Board (under Labour Department) provides social protection to informal sector workers not covered by ESI or EPFO — including street vendors, domestic workers, auto/taxi drivers, barbers, washermen, sanitation workers, cobblers, and others. Benefits: (1) Accidental death ₹2 lakh; (2) Permanent disability ₹1 lakh; (3) Maternity ₹6,000; (4) Marriage of daughter ₹3,000; (5) Funeral assistance ₹3,000; (6) Educational assistance ₹500-₹3,000/year for children. Annual registration ₹30. 1 crore+ workers registered. Apply at Labour Department TN / e-Sevai centres

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Free Power for Farmers 2026 — 9 Hours Free Electricity Daily for Agricultural Pumpsets
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister's Free Electricity Scheme for Farmers provides free electricity (up to 9 hours daily during off-peak hours) for all registered agricultural pumpsets in Tamil Nadu. All farmers with agricultural service connections (pumpsets up to 10HP) get completely free power supply without any monthly bill. Scheme introduced in 1989, expanded and continued through successive governments. Currently covers 22 lakh+ agricultural pumpset connections in Tamil Nadu. Domestic households: free units up to 100 units/month (separate scheme). The scheme costs Tamil Nadu government ₹12,000+ crore annually. Apply for new agricultural pumpset connection at TANGEDCO offices or online at tneb.in

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Adi Dravidar & Tribal Welfare Hostels & Scholarships 2026 — Free Hostel + ₹15,000 Top-up for SC/ST
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department (ADT) runs 450+ government hostels across Tamil Nadu providing free accommodation, meals, and study facilities for SC and ST students from Class 6 to PG. Additionally, ADT provides: (1) Free school uniform and bags (Class 1-12); (2) Pre-matric scholarship ₹150-₹750/month; (3) Post-matric scholarship top-up ₹2,000-₹15,000/year (additional to NSP central scholarship); (4) Coaching for civil services, UPSC, TNPSC, banking for SC/ST candidates (free residential coaching); (5) Special scholarship for SC/ST students pursuing MBBS, Engineering, Law, MBA: ₹15,000-₹25,000/year. Apply at ADT district offices or scholarships via NSP/TN Scholar portal

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Ex-Servicemen Welfare Scheme 2026 — Education Grants + Pension Top-up + State Employment for ESM
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu Sainik Welfare Board provides welfare assistance to ex-servicemen (ESM), war widows, and Veer Naris in Tamil Nadu. Key benefits: (1) Tamil Nadu state ex-gratia to gallantry awardees (Param Vir Chakra, Maha Vir Chakra, Vir Chakra, Ashoka Chakra, Shaurya Chakra families); (2) 10% horizontal reservation in Tamil Nadu state government jobs and PSUs for ESM; (3) Financial assistance to ESM in distress (₹5,000-₹30,000 one-time); (4) Children's education scholarship ₹750-₹1,500/month; (5) Priority in government plots and TNHB housing; (6) Free travel on TNSTC buses; (7) ECHS health coverage linkage. Apply at District Sainik Welfare Offices in all 38 TN districts

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Thooimai Kavalar Sanitation Workers Welfare 2026 — ₹5L Insurance + Housing Priority for Safai Workers
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu Thooimai Kavalar (Sanitation Workers) welfare scheme provides comprehensive protection to sanitation workers, scavengers, and solid waste management workers employed by ULBs, municipalities, corporations, and panchayats in Tamil Nadu. Benefits under Tamil Nadu Manual Scavengers Rehabilitation Act: (1) Accident insurance ₹5 lakh; (2) Rehabilitation training + ₹2,000/month stipend during training; (3) Housing priority under PMAY-U (1 BHK flat); (4) Children free education at government schools + scholarship ₹5,000/year; (5) 3% horizontal reservation in TN government jobs; (6) Alternative livelihood loan ₹50,000-₹5 lakh at 4% interest. Implemented by SC Welfare Department + ULBs

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu BC/MBC/DNT Post-Matric Scholarship 2026 — Full Tuition + ₹1,200/Month for Backward Class Students
schemes.benefit_summary: Distinct from Tamil Nadu's state-run BC/MBC/DNC post-matric scholarship, this is the **central-scheme variant** for BC/MBC/DNT students — funded by the Ministry of Social Justice at Delhi and implemented in Tamil Nadu through the state Backward Classes Welfare Department. Because it is a central scheme, applications flow through the National Scholarship Portal at scholarships.gov.in (not the state e-Scholarship Portal), and the annual family income ceiling is ₹2 lakh (versus the varying state-scheme ceilings). Around 5 lakh TN BC/MBC/DNT students draw this central scholarship each year — significantly smaller than the state scheme's 12 lakh reach, because many TN candidates who qualify for both prefer the state scheme's slightly more generous maintenance and its thesis/study-tour components. Maintenance runs ₹530 to ₹1,200 per month for hostellers with lower rates for day scholars, full tuition reimbursed. Applications open on NSP between July and November each year

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Disability Welfare & Rehabilitation 2026 — Free Assistive Devices + ₹5,000 Marriage + 4% Reservation
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu Differently Abled Welfare Department (beyond the monthly pension) provides comprehensive rehabilitation and welfare: (1) Free assistive devices — motorised tricycle, wheelchair, hearing aid, prosthetic limbs under ADIP (Assistance to Disabled Persons) scheme; (2) ₹50,000 marriage assistance for PWD couple (or PWD marrying able-bodied); (3) 4% reservation in TN government jobs (horizontal); (4) Free travel on TNSTC buses for 40%+ PWD; (5) Free education at District Rehabilitation Centres and Residential Special Schools; (6) Tamil Nadu Differently Abled Industrial Cooperative Societies (TIDCO) — loans for PWD entrepreneurs; (7) Scholarship ₹500-₹2,000/month for PWD students; (8) Property tax exemption

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Salt Pan Workers Welfare Scheme 2026 — ₹3L Accident + Housing + Pension for Salt Workers
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu Salt Pan Workers Welfare Board provides social security to salt pan workers in the coastal salt producing districts — Thoothukudi, Ramanathapuram, Nagapattinam, Villupuram, Chennai, Tiruvallur. Benefits: (1) Accidental death/disability insurance ₹3 lakh; (2) Monthly pension ₹1,500/month after age 60; (3) Maternity ₹6,000; (4) Children education scholarship ₹500-₹3,000/year; (5) Marriage of daughter ₹3,000; (6) Funeral ₹3,000; (7) Housing priority under PMAY-G/U. Annual registration ₹25. Managed by Tamil Nadu Labour Department. Around 1 lakh+ salt pan workers registered

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Sports Achievement Award & Sports Development Scheme 2026
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister's Sports Development Scheme and Sports Achievement Awards support athletes, sports persons, and youth engaged in sporting activities across Tamil Nadu. Key components: (1) CM's Sporting Achievement Award — ₹10,000-₹30 lakh cash award for international medalists (Olympic bronze ₹1 crore, silver ₹2 crore, gold ₹3 crore); (2) Sports Scholarship for youth — ₹500-₹2,000/month for top-ranked athletes in recognized sports; (3) Tamil Nadu Sports Development Authority (SDAT) free coaching academies in all districts; (4) Sports equipment subsidy for schools and colleges; (5) Priority government jobs for sports persons under sports quota (2% in government posts). Tamil Nadu has produced P V Sindhu-equivalent athletes across Kabaddi, Boxing, Chess (Magnus Carlsen opponents)

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Housing Board Affordable Housing 2026 — EWS/LIG Flats ₹3-10 Lakh
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu Housing Board (TNHB) allots affordable residential flats to EWS (Economically Weaker Section) and LIG (Lower Income Group) applicants across Tamil Nadu. EWS flats are priced at ₹3-5 lakh and LIG flats at ₹6-10 lakh — far below market rates — with home loan linkage through TNHB or HDFC/SBI. Allotment is through draw of lots (lottery). Additional subsidy of ₹2.5 lakh is available under PMAY-Urban Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) for EWS first-time home buyers. Around 30,000 families benefit each scheme cycle. Apply at tnhb.gov.in

schemes.title: Tamil Nadu Uzhavar Pathukappu — Farmer Input Subsidy + Crop Insurance 2026
schemes.benefit_summary: Tamil Nadu Uzhavar Pathukappu (Farmer Protection) is the state's comprehensive input subsidy scheme for small and marginal farmers — providing free/subsidised seeds (paddy, pulses, millets, oilseeds), 50% subsidy on bio-fertilizers, 50-75% subsidy on sprinkler/drip irrigation, free soil health card + testing, and free crop insurance premium (PMFBY/RWBCIS) for small farmers. Around 50 lakh farmer families in Tamil Nadu benefit. Apply through Agriculture Extension Officer / Block Agricultural Office or agri.tn.gov.in
